source_name: КаСис АД Скопје (CaSys) — corporate site / processing centre
why_relevant: National card processing centre (ATM/POS driving, e-commerce, card personalisation, Diners Club processor). Its board/CEO changes (e.g. Лидија Вучидолова-Богоевска, Филомена Пљаковска Аспровска appear in public sources as senior figures) and hiring ads are core to this cell.

source_name: CaSys — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Employee-count trend, new-hire announcements and executive posts (e.g. leadership posts by CaSys senior staff) are visible here earlier than on the corporate site.

source_name: IT.mk — MK tech/fintech media
why_relevant: Covers the Law on Payment Services from the fintech-industry angle and profiles MK PSP/fintech startups and their founders/CTOs — useful for CTO-level moves that banking media miss.

source_name: MKD.mk — general news, fintech licensing coverage
why_relevant: Broke EMI licence stories for Флекс пеј (Flex Pay) and Иуте пеј (Iute Pay) — licence news is the trigger event for new payments org build-outs and hiring waves.

source_name: Sakam Da Kazam (sdk.mk) — investigative/economy coverage of new payment institutions
why_relevant: Covers entry of new payment institutions and NBRSM fee decisions with named company detail; useful pointer to newly licensed PSPs before they appear in registries the analyst can reach.

source_name: Meta.mk — coverage of NBRSM payment-services bylaws and market opening
why_relevant: Explains the regulatory timeline that creates the licensed PSP/EMI population; good for dating regime shifts that drive org build-outs.

source_name: Pari.com.mk — business daily (Paysera Macedonia first EMI licence)
why_relevant: Identified Paysera Македонија as the first licensed EMI in MK — a key new actor in this cell with its own country-manager/CTO layer.

source_name: Off.net.mk — tech/consumer news covering PSP licences
why_relevant: Independent second confirmation of EMI/PSP licence events (Iute Pay), helpful for de-duplicating and dating actor entries.

source_name: Fakulteti.mk — job board carrying payments-sector vacancies (CaSys ads)
why_relevant: Carries verbatim job ads from payments infrastructure firms (e.g. КаСис АД Скопје), giving role-level hiring signal and implicit org-structure information.

source_name: SeeNews — SEE company news wire (executive appointments)
why_relevant: English-language wire that reliably reports MK financial-sector CEO appointments; useful for cross-border/regional PSP parent-company moves affecting MK country managers.

source_name: bne IntelliNews — regional fintech/market coverage (Nayax entry into MK)
why_relevant: Covers foreign payment acquirers/processors entering MK (Nayax), which typically precedes country-manager appointments and local hiring.

source_name: Nayax — corporate newsroom (MK market entry)
why_relevant: Primary announcements from a foreign PSP now operating in MK; company press releases name regional leadership and signal local team build-out.

source_name: Iute Group / Iute Pay DOOEL Skopje — investor announcements and MK careers
why_relevant: Listed parent of a MK-licensed EMI; regulated-issuer announcements disclose licence grants and management appointments, and its MK arm advertises payments roles (payments specialist).

source_name: Licentium — North Macedonia licensing hub (PSP/EMI licence tracker)
why_relevant: Third-party consolidation of MK payment/EMI licensing requirements and licensed-entity context; useful pointer when the NBRSM site is bot-blocked.

source_name: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) — Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems, consolidated text
why_relevant: Defines the licensed-entity categories, the fit-and-proper/management-approval requirements and the registers the National Bank must keep — the legal scaffolding that makes leadership changes at PSPs publicly observable.

source_name: Mastercard Newsroom Europe (press releases)
why_relevant: Primary issuer of Mastercard leadership appointment announcements covering the Southeast Europe cluster that includes North Macedonia; confirmed carrying the Bartosz Ciolkowski GM Southeast Europe appointment release naming North Macedonia in scope.

source_name: Mastercard Europe Leadership team page
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of Mastercard Europe/SEE leadership; diffing this page over time reveals org changes affecting the MK cluster before or without a press release.

source_name: Visa Newsroom CEMEA / Visa press releases
why_relevant: Visa announces CEMEA regional-president and country/group-country-manager appointments here; MK sits under a CEMEA SEE/CIS grouping, so scheme-side org changes touching MK surface in this channel rather than in MK media.

source_name: Visa Navigate CEMEA (regional thought-leadership portal)
why_relevant: Bylines and interview subjects on Visa Navigate CEMEA identify who currently owns Southeast Europe markets for Visa, an indirect route to the MK account owner when no appointment release exists.

source_name: Vrabotuvanje.com.mk (leading MK job board)
why_relevant: Largest MK job board (licensed agency since 2004, reported among the 15 most-visited .mk sites). Vendor and scheme hiring in MK - Printec, ASEE, CaSys, processors - surfaces here as job ads, which are the earliest observable signal of a local team build-out or a new country lead's mandate.

source_name: Printec Group - North Macedonia country page
why_relevant: Vendor's own MK entity page (Printec Technologies Skopje, in market since 2006); paired with the group Leadership page it is the authoritative statement of who runs the MK operation and how it is positioned.

source_name: LinkedIn - North Macedonia payments vendor people and company pages
why_relevant: The cell rationale holds: vendor and scheme country roles for MK are announced on LinkedIn far more often than in MK media. A Printec Group 'Country Lead' based in North Macedonia (Aleksandar Bajkov) was discoverable only via LinkedIn, not via any press release found.

source_name: Club200.mk company profiles (ASSECO SEE / ASEE Skopje)
why_relevant: MK company-profile aggregator carrying registered officers and financials for vendor legal entities; officer lists are an indirect, filing-derived way to detect leadership change at ASEE and peer vendors when no announcement is made.

source_name: CompanyWall Macedonia - ASEE DOOEL Skopje and vendor entities
why_relevant: Second independent MK registry-derived aggregator; cross-checking it against Club200 catches officer changes at vendor subsidiaries (ASEE, Printec, CaSys) and confirms name/entity changes such as ASSECO SEE to ASEE.

source_name: Makfax - corporate announcements (соопштенија) section
why_relevant: MK news agency that republishes vendor corporate announcements verbatim (carried the ASSECO SEE to ASEE rename), making it a reliable capture point for vendor-issued MK-language statements including personnel and org changes.

source_name: eMagazin.mk
why_relevant: MK business magazine that reports board and management appointments in the financial sector in Macedonian; useful for catching bank-side counterparts of vendor/scheme moves and occasionally vendor executives themselves.
